name: The Beverly Hills Hotel
positioning: Dorchester Collection hotel known as the 'Pink Palace', set in 12 acres of tropical gardens on Sunset Boulevard in Beverly Hills
best_for: Travelers who want Old Hollywood history, from the Polo Lounge to the poolside cabanas
Guests who want a Sunset Boulevard base a short drive from Rodeo Drive

facts.text: The hotel is at 9641 Sunset Boulevard in Beverly Hills, in the 90210 zip code.
Rodeo Drive is about a 5-minute drive from the hotel.
The hotel is surrounded by 12 acres of tropical gardens.
The hotel is known as the 'Pink Palace'.
The Polo Lounge serves American cuisine with an Italian edge.
The Polo Lounge lunch menu includes the McCarthy salad.
A piano player serenades Polo Lounge diners at lunch and dinner, and Sunday brunch on the patio comes with light jazz.
The Cabana Cafe is the hotel's al fresco poolside restaurant.
The poolside cabanas come with Apple TV, a mini fridge and lounge chairs.
The spa has a duet suite, a nail suite and locker facilities with steam showers.
The Crystal Ballroom is an Art Deco space with rose chandeliers and French doors overlooking the Crystal Garden.

highlights.text: The pool dates back to 1938, when it opened as 'The Sand and Pool Club', with sand to make it feel like a beach club.
Leonard Bernstein came up with the idea for West Side Story in cabana 3.
The Polo Lounge has a candy-striped ceiling.
The Fountain Coffee Room is a 19-stool diner.
Bungalow 5 is outfitted in colors from Elizabeth Taylor's jewelry collection.

considerations.text: Breakfast is not automatically included in room rates.
The Polo Lounge has a dress code that excludes baseball caps, flip-flops and sportswear.
